text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having safely made her debut, Gold City 
immediately considers her future path 
after the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold City chooses the Tiara route. The 
fans are anticipating a Triple Tiara. It 
seems she decided she wants to live up to 
those hopes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her next goal is the prelude to the Tiara 
route: the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies.
